catalyst_observation.source_statement: Topline 24-week results from the Phase 2b portion of the IMPAHCT study: AV-101 did not meet its primary endpoint (change in pulmonary vascular resistance vs. placebo) at any studied dose, and did not show meaningful improvement on the secondary six-minute-walk-distance endpoint, despite being well tolerated - a standalone, single-issue efficacy-miss disclosure with no bundled positive framing (contrast the rejected Spruce Biosciences filing evaluated for this same batch). Aerovate's FY2023 10-K (filed 2024-03-25, the most recent pre-event annual filing) states: 'Our business is entirely dependent on the successful development, regulatory approval and commercialization of AV-101, our only product candidate under development.' Pre-promotion single-asset evidence already recorded as QUALIFIES; see single-asset-evidence-ledger-11.json.
